safe_environment: Existing controlled disposable real BFF/PostgreSQL harness only; no production/provider abuse

sources.mapping: Review per-object authorization of draft/operation, own actor versus BU admin, foreign tenant404, current grants before replay and dispatch; UUID obscurity is not authorization.

Inspect bounded definition/cursor/page payloads, response byte and timeout limits, account/actor moving-window quota and shared refresh lease/debounce; distinguish max page20/50 from bounded child SQL.

Inspect existing cookie session and custom non-simple mutation header with actual CORS owner. Inherited middleware remains unchanged; new routes must receive it by prefix. Test missing header/session and ensure no effects.

trust_boundary_map: Browser untrusted ID/definition/revision/key -> BFF session/CSRF -> scoped draft owner
Authorized local draft/account metadata -> operation-bound provider -> private credential lookup
Untrusted remote response/cursor -> strict parser and safe typed outcome -> persistent shared observation fence
Durable PostgreSQL operation/receipts -> reload/UI no inferred external authorship
limitations: Source refresh guides independent threat assessment; no vulnerability reproduced by browsing
No new dependency or framework version change is authorized
Process deviation positive-pathspec omission must be disposed factually without investigating protected files
Do not claim security gate pass until fresh independent review and exact scope evidence are complete
